Layer.UpdateCommand: %function(self) local songg = GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() or GAMESTATE:GetCurrentCourse() if songg then self:finishtweening() self:hidden(0) self:settext(songg:GetDisplayFullTitle()) self:diffuse(0,1,1,1) self:zoom(0.6) self:decelerate(0.2) self:diffuse(1,1,1,1) self:zoom(0.5) else self:hidden(1) end end

%function(self) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() then self:finishtweening() self:hidden(0) self:settext(GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():GetDisplayArtist()) self:diffuse(0,1,1,1) self:zoom(0.8) self:decelerate(0.15) self:diffuse(1,1,1,1) self:zoom(0.7) else self:hidden(1) end end
